verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe a dedicated feature that automatically drafts a follow-up email after an external meeting, using the transcript, calendar and past Gmail threads, "so you can send it in a couple of clicks." Granola Chat can also draft and send follow-up emails, with a review step before anything is sent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality, and documentation of email-client support beyond Gmail.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks

citations.quote: After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email - using context from your transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads - so you can send it in a couple of clicks.
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
Ask Chat to: draft and send a follow-up email
